title: Amendment refused: window joinery flashing and timber remediation on a three-storey timber building

facts.text: The subject building is now a three-storey timber-framed residential building; the amendment application incorporates a revised timber remediation methodology and a proposed window flashing system for the existing window joinery.

Figure 1 shows the jamb detail of the flashing system (p.2); Figure 2 shows the head and sill detail (p.3); both are marked not to scale.
The determination considers whether sufficient information was provided to the authority during the building consenting process.
